review.--Insomnia Gaming Festival--:
This event is split into 2 parts. 

You have the convention side, which is your typical convention but with more of a gaming focus, then you have the LAN side. 

The LAN offers a space that is open from 6PM Friday to 6PM Sunday - a full 72 hours. 

There are also facilties that are open for LAN.

review.--Runefest--:
Runefest is different to other events ive been to. 

Other events often have an artist alley, theme-adjacent vendors and panel. 

Runefest doesnt have any of that. its panels are from the Jmods, the only merch is the official stall. 

there are plenty of party games and collectables. you really do feel you are in the land of Gilinor.
